description_ru: Размышление о том, что приятнее читать: бумажную книгу или текст на экране.
text:
I love reading, but I do not like reading on my phone. I prefer paper books, and I want to tell you why.

First, a book does not hurt my eyes. When I read on a screen for an hour, my eyes feel tired and dry. With a book I can read for three hours and feel fine.

Second, a phone is full of messages. Every few minutes it makes a noise, and I stop reading. A book is quiet. It does not send me news or videos, so I can think about the story.

Also, I like the smell of a new book and the feel of the pages. I can write notes in it, and I can lend it to a friend.

Of course, phones have good points. You can carry hundreds of books in your pocket, and it is cheaper. But for me, a real book is still better. What do you think?

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Поставьте кончик языка между зубами и выдохните без голоса; не заменяйте звук на «с» или «ф».
Кончик языка поднят к нёбу, но не касается его и не вибрирует; губы чуть округлены.
Долгий «и»: растяните звук, губы в улыбке; не путайте с коротким ɪ.
p, t, k в начале слова произносите с лёгким придыханием, как будто выдыхаете «х».

questions.question: What happens when the phone makes a noise?
What can you do with a book and a friend?
Why is a phone good?
questions.answer: You can carry many books and it is cheaper.
